svg.title: ProductIVF V2 — six neon logo variants
svg.desc: Two columns compare the dark faceted direction with the smooth luminous blue direction. Rows show a standalone P, a large P paired with IVF, and all four letters PIVF.

g.text: Continuous forms. Longer stems. A subtle release of blocks at the tip.

svg.title: ProductIVF — Neon Facet P
svg.desc: A continuous charcoal P with a chamfered bowl, a long smooth tail, and luminous cyan-blue dimensional edges. Exactly three tiny cubes fade immediately below the terminal tip.

svg.title: ProductIVF — Neon Facet P + IVF
svg.desc: A large continuous neon cyan-blue and charcoal P with a long smooth tail stands beside separate outlined IVF lettering. Three tiny fading cubes appear only below the P terminal tip.

svg.title: ProductIVF — Neon Facet PIVF
svg.desc: Four aligned custom vector letters form PIVF in charcoal with luminous cyan-blue dimensional edges. The P has a continuous extended tail and only three tiny fading cubes below its terminal tip.

svg.title: ProductIVF — Neon fused P
svg.desc: A single smooth electric-blue P on near black. Its long uninterrupted stem ends in three small fading task cells. All artwork remains editable vector geometry.

svg.title: ProductIVF — Neon fused P with separate IVF
svg.desc: An oversized smooth electric-blue P with a long continuous stem and three tiny fading terminal cells, paired with smaller separate vector IVF lettering on near black.

svg.title: ProductIVF — Neon fused PIVF
svg.desc: Four full-height vector letters form a continuous electric-blue PIVF wordmark. The P retains its extended smooth stem and only three tiny fading cells at the terminal tip. The background is near black.
